title: Your First Function
brief:
A function gives a name to a group of statements so you can run them whenever you like:

def climb():
    jump_right()
    jump_right()
    jump_right()

Writing def only defines the function — nothing moves until you call it by writing climb() on a line of its own.

Climb the three steps with your function, then walk down the far side.
solution:
def climb():
    jump_right()
    jump_right()
    jump_right()

climb()
